title: A seat at the high table
text: A sealed invitation arrives: a Great House holds its winter feast and your name is on the seating chart — near enough to the salt to matter.

effects.tpl: You toast the host in the old words and mean them. Doors open that money alone never could. +12 prestige.
Silver candlesticks, no card. They notice the taste, if not the absence. +3 prestige.

then.tpl: Your absence becomes the gossip of the feast — played exactly right, it reads as power. +6 fame.

else.tpl: Played wrong. The slight is remembered at every table that matters. −15 prestige.
